summary: First full test run of OLAM 3.0 (FastAPI + Expo web at 390x844). Backend: 18/20 pytest pass. All requested core flows pass: admin login and wrong-password 401; public branches/batches; registration with OLM-XXXXXX reference; case-insensitive duplicate student_code -> 409; confirm=false -> 422; lookup (pending -> null token, wrong email -> 404, approved -> token); coordinator branch scoping (403 on br-2, list returns only br-1, CSV only own branch); scanner gets 403 on approve, stats and export; scan VALID then ALREADY_CHECKED_IN; 5 parallel scans give exactly 1 VALID and 1 attendance row; garbage -> INVALID; manual OLM ref works; pending ref -> NOT_APPROVED; reject revokes the pass (REVOKED); re-approve issues a new token and the old one is no longer VALID; stats match the DB; pass/verify returns 200 or 404 as expected; deactivated staff token -> 401. The 2 failures are validation gaps: a coordinator can be created with no branch_id or a non-existent branch_id. Frontend: every requested flow works end to end (landing -> register -> confirmation shows reference -> status lookup pending/rejected-with-reason/approved -> View my digital pass -> QR pass card renders; invalid pass token error; staff login error and success; dashboard overview stats, registrations, approve, reject modal with reason; scanner manual input gives VALID / ALREADY CHECKED IN / NOT APPROVED / INVALID cards; settings add branch and batch; manage staff creates a coordinator; coordinator dashboard has no settings tab and shows only Branch 1). Problems found: layout overflow, touch targets under 44px, a /status deep-link clash with the Metro dev server, a missing branch name on NOT_APPROVED/REVOKED scan results, duplicate dashboard in the navigation stack, and missing testIDs. No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner not used; expo-camera ~58 is used). No SafeAreaView issues (react-native-safe-area-context insets are used).

minor.issue: role=coordinator is accepted with no branch_id (200). That coordinator then gets 403 on /stats and an empty list. Require branch_id for coordinators.
branch_id is not checked against db.branches, so a coordinator with branch_id='br-doesnotexist' is created (200). Return 400 for an invalid branch.

NOT_APPROVED and REVOKED responses return branch_id but not branch_name, while VALID/ALREADY_CHECKED_IN return branch_name. The scanner card therefore shows ' • Batch A' with an empty branch. Reference: server.py:660, 672, 678

The scanner role can list every registration in every branch, including mobile and email PII. The scanner only needs /scan and /scan/history. Consider removing scanner from require_roles on the list and detail endpoints (server.py:522, 549).

plain_token is stored next to token_hash (server.py:567, 575), which defeats the purpose of hashing. A DB leak exposes every valid pass. Acceptable for an MVP retrieval flow, but consider deterministic HMAC-derived tokens or encrypting plain_token.

The comment says the email is fire-and-forget, but _send_pass_email is awaited (timeout 20s). Measured latency is about 0.5s now, but a slow email provider would block the approve response. Use BackgroundTasks or asyncio.create_task.

ui_bugs.issue: Deep-linking or refreshing <preview>/status?ref=..&email=.. returns the plain-text 'packager-status:running'. Metro reserves /status, so the dev server intercepts it. In-app navigation works. Renaming the route (e.g. /lookup or /my-registration) avoids this in preview and Expo Go web.

ui_bugs.component: Settings add-branch/add-batch rows and Scanner manual row
ui_bugs.issue: The 'Add' and 'Check' GoldButtons overflow past the card or screen right edge at 390px (Add button runs to x≈390 while the card ends at 370). The likely cause is the RN-web TextInput's intrinsic min width inside a flex:1 row. Add minWidth:0 / flexShrink:1 to the TextInputPill in these rows.

The dashboard pushes /staff/scanner (dashboard.tsx:111) and the scanner's Dashboard button uses router.replace('/staff/dashboard') (scanner.tsx:81). This leaves 2 dashboard screens mounted, so duplicate testIDs resolve to 2 elements. Use router.back() when canGoBack().
The 'Please confirm your information is accurate.' error stays visible after the confirm checkbox is ticked, until the next submit.

issues: '← Home' / '← Back' links and scanner 'Dashboard'/'Sign out' text links are under 44px. Add hitSlop or minHeight 44.
The gold 'DELTA ACADEMY' brand mark has very low contrast against the light hero photo.
The hero image loads late (~3-5s), so a large empty navy area shows first. Consider a placeholder or blurhash.
The camera frame border cuts through the 'Camera permission needed' title and body text.
The 'Confirm reject' label wraps onto 2 lines in the half-width button.
The '← Back' link and the 'STAFF MANAGEMENT' eyebrow are cramped with no vertical spacing.
The footer text ('present this pass again on return only if the gate re-admits') contradicts 'One scan per guest'.

action_items: POST/PATCH /api/staff: require branch_id when role=coordinator and check that it exists in db.branches (return 400).
POST /api/scan: include branch_name in NOT_APPROVED and REVOKED responses (server.py:660,672,678).
Rename the /status route (Metro dev server reserves /status) and update router.push targets in confirmation.tsx and index.tsx.
Fix the inline input+button rows overflowing on mobile (settings add branch/batch, scanner manual check): give the TextInputPill minWidth:0 / flexShrink.
Raise touch targets to 44px (tabs, filter chips, text links) using minHeight or hitSlop.
Scanner Dashboard button: use router.back() instead of replace to avoid duplicate dashboard screens.
Optional: remove scanner access to GET /api/registrations (PII); run the approval email in the background; clear the register confirm error when the box is ticked.
Add missing testIDs: status '← Home', confirmation 'Back to home', manage '← Back', reject modal Cancel, staff modal Cancel, login '← Home'.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 942 lines, over the 700-line guideline. Split it into routers (auth, registrations, scan, admin).
Duplicate-safe check-in correctly relies on the unique index on attendance.registration_id plus DuplicateKeyError. Verified under 5 concurrent requests.
Revocation works: reject sets passes.active=false and re-approve rotates token_hash, so the old token becomes INVALID.
The CSV export and the registrations list run N+1 queries per row (branch + attendance lookups). Fine for small events but slow at about 5000 registrations. Use $lookup or caching.
CORS allow_origins=['*'] is acceptable since JWT is carried in the bearer header.
Scanner same-token debounce of 2.5s (scanner.tsx:48) also applies to manual input, so a staff member re-checking the same reference within 2.5s sees nothing happen.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows functional; layout and touch-target issues reported

seed_data_creation: Test registrations, staff (test_*@olam.delta) and TEST branches/batches were created and then removed with tests/cleanup_test_data.py. A real registration 'Amal G Krishna' (OLM-8932B1) was left untouched.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && python -m pytest tests/test_olam_api.py -n 0 -v (pytest.ini enables xdist, so pass -n 0 for deterministic shared fixtures). Base URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in /app/frontend/.env. Afterwards run python tests/cleanup_test_data.py. In the UI, reach /status through landing-retrieve-btn; do not deep-link /status (Metro intercepts it). The dashboard registrations tab defaults to the PENDING filter. Scanner manual input has a 2.5s same-value debounce. Camera scanning cannot be tested headless.
rca_of_issue: /status deep-link: Metro dev server middleware answers GET /status with 'packager-status:running' before Expo Router's web handler. Coordinator without a branch: StaffCreateIn has no model_validator tying role=coordinator to a required, existing branch_id.
